items.headline: Binance Hack Sends $BNB Down 7% as Lazarus Link Emerges
items.summary: $BNB slid 7.1% after a hack on Binance, with SlowMist tying the attacker's laundering to North Korea's Lazarus Group. Co-CEO Yi He pledged full coverage of user losses.

items.headline: Pendle's $STRCX Smashes $50M Milestone at New ATH
items.summary: Pendle's $STRCX token crossed $50M and printed a fresh all-time high, signaling growing demand for tokenized yield on the protocol.

items.headline: Mystery Whale Pulls $290M Nightly, Spiking $AAVE Rates
items.summary: A mystery whale is withdrawing $290M from DeFi every midnight, tripling $AAVE borrowing rates and squeezing leveraged loopers.

items.headline: $FLUID Opens DEX v2 Beta With Custom Collateral Ranges
items.summary: $FLUID launched its DEX v2 beta, letting LPs set custom collateral and debt ranges — a fresh DeFi primitive worth watching early.

items.headline: Stellar's Thruput Benchmark Hints at $XLM Scaling Push
items.summary: Stellar unveiled Thruput with multi-million-transaction execution benchmarks, teeing up a scalability narrative for $XLM.
